claims.location: experimental design and exact RAW mapping
claims.value: Two Orbitrap Fusion Lumos acquisitions of an LMNA p.S143P patient-fibroblast digest, with and without a mutation-site inclusion list.
claims.evidence: PRIDE protocol, complete deposited file inventory, and accession-linked primary record; 2 of 2 RAW basenames covered exactly once.

limitations: Both acquisitions derive from the same patient-fibroblast source; they are technical/acquisition variants, not biological replicates.
Patient age, sex, ancestry, and fibroblast sampling site are not available in the accession-scoped record.
The reconciler's cleavage-agent warning is resolved by the PRIDE data-processing protocol, which explicitly states Enzyme: Trypsin.
